spans.s: अश्मादि a class of words headed by the word अश्मन् to which the taddh- ita affix र is applied in the four senses specified in
to 70; e.g. अश्मरः, ऊषरम् , नगरम् , पामरः गह्वरम् etc. cf.
अस्मद् first person; the term is used in the sense of the first person in the grammars of Hemacandra and Śākaṭāyana. cf. त्रीणि त्रीण्यन्ययुष्मदस्मदि (Hem.
